alice: Heads-up — planning a runtime kernel/quant swap tonight 01:00 UTC. Moving from kernel-quant v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0 (includes the new matmul micro-kernel and quant packing). Will run a 15m canary then staggered rollout. Need: release notes snippet, signed bundle, deploy-bot schedule + pin TTL, and clear rollback criteria.
ben: ack. can we pin Dedicated pool A for the canary slice? want isolation from bulk traffic. also: will the new kernel require a different driver ABI?
alice: good Q — driver ABI unchanged; only kernel micro-ops and a quant packing change. we should still quarantine a small percent of traffic (1-2%) to Dedicated A. after 15m, expand to 20% then 50/100.
carla: I'll draft release notes. include: matmul perf +6-12% w/short seqs, kv-cache compatibility check, new quant packing flag `--qpack=v2`. also add known issue: slight perf regression on very long sequences (tracked).
carla: release note draft: "Engine v3.3.0: matmul micro-kernel, qpack v2 (opt-in), telemetry on kv-cache miss-rate. Rollout plan and rollback triggers included."
dave: suggest rollback triggers: error-rate spike >0.3% sustained for 5m OR p50 latency increase >25% for 10m OR OOMs >0.1 incidents/instance in first 30m. if any trigger trips, auto-pin-back to previous image and notify oncall.
ben: +1 to those thresholds. also add token-level correctness regression alert (eval harness) — if LM test-set BLEU-like metric drops >2% we pull.
alice: good call. we'll wire the eval harness alert to the release runbook. who will sign the bundle? we need signed artifact for deploy-bot to accept.
carla: I can sign. command I will run: `gpg --armor --detach-sign artifacts/engine-v3.3.0-bundle.tar.gz` and upload `artifact.tar.gz.asc` to S3 path `s3://redwood-releases/engine/3.3.0/`
carla: also will attach short changelog to the release entry and ping product for the user-impact blurb.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: engine-v3.3.0 -> staging (canary) @ 2024-09-08T01:00:00Z. Bake window: 15m. Staged rollout commands: `deploy start --image engine-v3.3.0 --slice canary --pool dedicated-a --percent 2` then `deploy expand --percent 20` then `deploy expand --percent 50` then `deploy expand --percent 100`.
dave: nightwatch duty? I can take the 00:45-02:30UTC slot to watch canary metrics and be the rollback authority. will set pager to me.
alice: thanks dave. set deploy-bot followups: if any rollback trigger fires, auto-pin previous image and create incident with label `engine-rollback`.
ben: one more: pin TTL. keep the sticky pin for 90m after final expand in case we need to hold traffic back while we validate. then auto-unpin unless manually extended.
carla: signing done (will post link when uploaded). also adding the "known issue" section so release notes don't surprise anyone.
alice: perfect. I'll update release runbook with thresholds + commands. quick checklist: 1) carla signs & uploads artifact 2) ben reserves Dedicated A slice 3) deploy-bot scheduled with TTL 4) dave watches and can rollback 5) prod-eval harness wired.
ben: reserved Dedicated A and added a short firewall rule to isolate testing.
carla: upload link: s3://redwood-releases/engine/3.3.0/engine-v3.3.0-bundle.tar.gz.asc :thumbsup:
dave: oncall pager set, slack alert channel #eng-runtime-watch added. I'll post periodic checks every 5m during bake. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
alice: thanks team. will post final release note and close thread when done. :thumbsup:
